entities.name: ASG
entities.rationale: Icon at top labeled ASG, positioned above the dashed container of EC2 instances; auto scaling groups support the primary/backup EC2 instances.

entities.name: CloudFormation
entities.rationale: Pink icon labeled CLOUDFORMATION at left; used to deploy the solution (about 40 YAML templates). No explicit lines drawn from it.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled S3 at left; stores master files uploaded from Atlanta via Aspera; fans out to the three EC2 boxes.

entities.name: EC2 (AZ 1)
entities.rationale: Top EC2 icon inside its own blue box (an AZ) annotated '10' (10 channels), contained inside the orange dashed container (US East 1 region / ASG group). Runs Evertz ORT playout software.

entities.name: EC2 (AZ 2)
entities.rationale: Middle EC2 icon inside its own blue box (an AZ) annotated '10', contained inside the orange dashed container. Runs Evertz ORT playout software.

entities.name: EC2 (AZ 3)
entities.rationale: Bottom EC2 icon inside its own blue box (an AZ) annotated '10', contained inside the orange dashed container. Runs Evertz ORT playout software.

entities.name: Direct Connect
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled DIRECT CONNECT at right of the EC2 container; carries playout back to on-prem (Atlanta and New York).

entities.name: TWD/CNN Center
entities.rationale: Building drawing labeled TWD/CNN CENTER (Techwood/CNN Center Atlanta on-prem facility); source of master files and receiver of the 'X' chain playout.

entities.name: ATL Uplink
entities.rationale: Satellite dish drawing labeled ATL; uplink for distribution to affiliates, fed from the TWD/CNN Center.

entities.name: NYC Uplink (Hudson Yards)
entities.rationale: Satellite dish drawing labeled NYC; BCP path of eight channels via Direct Connect to Hudson Yards and its uplink.

visual_connections.description: Pink line running from below the TWD/CNN Center building along the bottom of the board and up to S3: master files sent via Aspera to S3.
Pink arrow from S3 to the top EC2 box: files transferred to local EC2 running ORT.
Pink arrow from S3 to the middle EC2 box.
Pink arrow from S3 to the bottom EC2 box.
Pink line from top EC2 to Direct Connect: playout signal leaving the cloud.
Pink line from middle EC2 to Direct Connect.
Pink line from bottom EC2 to Direct Connect.
Pink line labeled 'X' (X chain, tertiary path to air) from Direct Connect down to the on-prem building.
Pink arrow from the building going right and up to the ATL satellite dish: compressed signal to uplink for affiliates.
Pink arrow labeled 'BCP' from Direct Connect to the NYC dish: business continuity path, eight channels.
